title: Mailchimp Pricing Plans | Get Started Today | Mailchimp

facts.fact: Mailchimp's page says the Standard plan includes a 14-day free trial.
facts.quote: Find out why customers see up to 27x ROI\* using the Standard plan with a 14-day trial†.

facts.fact: Mailchimp claims customers see up to 27x ROI using the Standard plan; this is a vendor claim, not an independent figure.
facts.quote: Find out why customers see up to 27x ROI\* using the Standard plan with a 14-day trial†.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's Standard plan sends up to 6,000 emails each month.
facts.quote: Send up to 6,000 emails each month.

facts.fact: Mailchimp offers 15% off the Standard plan for businesses with 10,000+ contacts for their first 12 months.
facts.quote: Businesses with 10,000+ contacts can save 15% on their first 12 months.

facts.fact: The Mailchimp Standard plan is shown at $20.00 per month for 12 months in the pricing block, with the currency symbol displayed as $ and the page's currency selector listing USD.
Mailchimp's Premium plan sends up to 150,000 emails each month.
facts.quote: Send up to 150,000 emails each month.

facts.fact: The Mailchimp Premium plan is shown at $350.00 per month for 12 months in the pricing block, with the currency symbol displayed as $ and the page's currency selector listing USD.
Mailchimp offers 15% off the Premium plan for businesses with 10,000+ contacts for their first 12 months.
facts.quote: Engage your audience and increase sales with 15% off your first 12 months†.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's Standard and Premium plans list contact-based pricing tiers starting at 0-500 contacts and extending to 1,000,000+ contacts.
